obernants.operator: With fixed included TSV bytes, U is the tagged union of direct phrase lookups returning expression slices and token requests returning ExprMatch records; R is lazy row parsing and greedy matching. An inner approximant C to U minus R contains parsed rows originating from fewer than four columns. For ExprMatch outputs it additionally contains spans longer than six words, unresolved [[ glosses and unlabeled singleton readings. These matcher restrictions do not apply to direct expression() lookup slices, which return indexed rows. This is a scoped specification, not a certified runtime complement.
